WALLDEF1.DAX:1:1.title: Open masonry arch
WALLDEF1.DAX:1:1.brief: An original open passage in weathered masonry. Warm umber and slate stones with restrained mineral-green accents. Clear sightline through the arch; no emblems or recognizable franchise motifs.

WALLDEF1.DAX:1:4.title: Rugged masonry
WALLDEF1.DAX:1:4.brief: An original rugged stone wall. Large irregular masonry in warm umber and muted slate, with small chips and restrained mineral-green seams. No symbols or recognizable franchise motifs.

WALLDEF1.DAX:1:5.title: Closed wooden door
WALLDEF1.DAX:1:5.brief: An original closed wooden door in weathered masonry. Asymmetric stone frame and sturdy wood joinery, with warm umber and slate tones. No symbols or recognizable franchise motifs.

WALLDEF1.DAX:5:3.title: River marker
WALLDEF1.DAX:5:3.brief: An original abstract carved stone relief suggesting a branching river and three stars. Inset into weathered masonry. No religious symbol, heraldry, lettering, or recognizable franchise motif.
